description: This source file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages user authentication state and interactions with the AuthService, including login, registration, and logout functionalities, as well as listening to authentication state changes via Supabase.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages authentication state, user information, and provides methods for login, registration, and logout, integrating with Supabase and AuthService.

methods.name: _resolveUser
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the current user information based on the auth state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and role.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the auth state subscription and performs cleanup.
